what: A mysterious train adventure built around the FM-1's keys, knobs and sound engine, blending driving, mechanical puzzles, synth jams and rhythm games. Journey around a synthwave loop, repair forgotten machines through sound and logic, and uncover the mystery at its heart.
author: MammothCheese
sounds: own: every sound is synthesised in code; the WAVs in docs/audio are recordings of the firmware's own output
